# No, Hunter Biden Did Not Die From a Drug Overdose

## The false and distasteful rumor emerged from some dark corners of the internet in October 2020.

### Dan MacGuill

### Published Oct. 27, 2020

**Image courtesy of Paul Morigi/Getty Images for World Food Program USA**

Claim:

Hunter Biden died of a drug overdose in October 2020

**Voting in the 2020 U.S. Election may be over, but the misinformation keeps on ticking.** Never stop fact-checking. Follow our post-election coverage here.

In October 2020, a false and distasteful rumor emerged online that Hunter Biden, the 50-year-old son of Democratic presidential candidate Joe Biden, and the subject of several interconnected allegations related to his personal life and business affairs, had died from a drug overdose.

The claim appears to have originated on 4chan's /pol/ ("Politically Incorrect") thread, the birthplace of many dark, inflammatory and dangerous right-wing memes, rumors and conspiracy theories in recent years.

On Oct. 19, an anonymous user wrote on /pol/:

"Medical professional and long-time lurker here. Hunter Biden is being treated for a heroin overdose in my hospital and is in critical condition. Don't ask for proof or details because what I'm doing is highly illegal and were it not for my double VPN you wouldn't be reading this."

On Oct. 25, an anonymous user with a different ID wrote:

"Don't ask me how I know but Hunter Biden died of a crack overdose over 20 minutes ago. Joe is already on his way to the hospital."

The rumor that Biden had died spread online in the ensuing hours and days. Some observers were convinced of the credibility of the Oct. 25 post because the associated user had the same "Pepe the Frog" avatar as the anonymous user who announced the suicide of financier and convicted sex criminal Jeffrey Epstein in a New York prison in August 2019.

In particular, @NeonRevolt, an enthusiastic promoter of the QAnon cluster of conspiracy theories on various online platforms, popularized the claim that the person who announced Biden's death on Oct. 25 was the same person who used a similar formula of words to announce Epstein's death in August 2019:

In reality, different individuals can use the same avatar when posting to 4chan, and no evidence existed to demonstrate that the person behind the Epstein announcement was the same person who claimed that Biden had died of a drug overdose in October 2020.

In any event, the announcement of Biden's death was false. His attorney, George Mesires, confirmed to Snopes that Hunter Biden was alive, writing "The rumor is false."

The false announcement of Biden's death quickly prompted speculation and conspiracy theories. The specific claim that he had died from a drug overdose was particularly distasteful, given that Biden has spoken publicly about his long battle with alcohol and drug addiction.

# Fact check: False rumors that Hunter Biden is dead are a 4chan hoax

Camille Caldera

USA TODAY

Oct. 27, 2020, 6:49 p.m. ET

## The claim: Hunter Biden died of a drug overdose

Rumors that Hunter Biden — the son of former Vice President Joe Biden — has died of an overdose have appeared on Facebook this week.

"I have unconfirmed reports Hunter Biden has either died from a crack overdose or is in serious condition.... ANYONE have any info on this?" Elizabeth Sequoria posted.

Sequoria declined a request for comment from USA TODAY.

"Word on the street is Hunter Biden is possibly now dead, apparently from a 'drug overdose,'" Kat Dekari Zaghi wrote.

On Instagram, some accounts — including BATEFM and Guntraband — also posted a screenshot of a headline from the site Hollywood News LA that read "Joe Biden’s Son Hunter Died From Drug Overdose in Suicide Attempt?"

Zaghi, BATEFM, Guntraband and Hollywood News LA have not responded to requests from USA TODAY for comment.

## Hoax about his death originated on 4chan

There is no proof to support the claim that Hunter Biden is dead. Both Lead Stories and Heavy also concluded that the claim is false.

The unfounded rumor appears to have started with a post on 4chan, which is archived here. It was posted Oct. 25 on a board titled "Politically Incorrect."

“Hunter Biden died of a crack overdose over 20 minutes ago," it reads. "Joe is already on his way to the hospital."

A week before Election Day, reporters in the press pool are appraised of almost every move a presidential candidate like Joe Biden makes.

On Sunday, Oct. 25, Biden attended church in Wilmington, Delaware, with his granddaughters and appeared at a virtual concert later that night, per the Associated Press.

On Monday, Oct. 26, he made a surprise appearance in Delaware County, Pennsylvania, per the Philadelphia Inquirer. On Tuesday, Oct. 27, Biden was set to campaign in Georgia, per The Hill.

Hunter Biden, by contrast, lives in Los Angeles, per the New York Times. He is a recovering drug addict, something he and his father have been open about.

Hunter Biden is also the only surviving child from his father's first marriage. His sister, Naomi, died as an infant in a car crash, alongside his mother, per the Associated Press. His brother, Beau, died in 2015 of brain cancer.

## Our rating: False

Based on our research, the claim that Hunter Biden has died is FALSE. There is no evidence to support it, and it appears to be a hoax that originated on 4chan.

## Our fact-check sources:

* Lead Stories, Oct. 26, Fact Check: NO Evidence That Hunter Biden Is Dead
* Heavy, Oct. 26, Hunter Biden Is Not Dead: Overdose Story Is a 4chan Death Hoax
* 4chan, Oct. 25, thread
* Associated Press, Oct. 25, The Latest: Biden attends church, plans push on early voting
* Philadelphia Inquirer, Oct. 26, Biden makes surprise stop in Delco; Trump holds 3 rallies in Pa.; Philly residents flock to early voting sites
* The Hill, Oct. 27, Oct. 27: Where Biden and Trump are campaigning today
* The New York Times, Feb. 28, There’s a New Artist in Town. The Name Is Biden.
